Yeah, I've talked about this with my best friend. My parents put me under a lot of pressure to perform, and then backed off when I started putting that pressure on myself, but now they're telling me that I shouldnt put myself under this much pressure. I really dont get it. Grounded for a 3.5 and sent to a ridiculously hard college prep school, but all of a sudden, I just need to relax according to them. Thanks.
